Jack Heart approved (2026-10-27): rollups can be materialized at eval time (at seal, as now) and also defined at query time. statsdb(..., rollups=...) computes a missing rollup's per-match partials once per existing block from that block's tables, keeps them locally, and never recomputes them. A definition is identified by name plus digest. A query-time rollup is not written to the store. See the newest Decisions entry in scratch/jack-heart-eb70f8-keep-each-eval.md; build this together with the join/player/opponents/expression-sums extension.
